description: This source file implements file copying utilities, including copying file descriptors, setting file times, and copying files with permissions and timestamps adjustments.

methods.name: int copy_fd(int ifd,int ofd)
methods.description: Copies data from one file descriptor to another byte-by-byte, handling read and write errors.

methods.name: int copy_times(const char * dst,const char * src)
methods.description: Copies the modification and access times from a source file to a destination file.

methods.name: int copy_file(const char * dst,const char * src,int mode)
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination, setting permissions, and handles error reporting.

methods.name: int copy_file_with_time(const char * dst,const char * src,int mode)
methods.description: Performs file copy and then copies the timestamps from source to destination.

ctags.name: copy_file
ctags.pattern: /^int copy_file(const char *dst, const char *src, int mode)$/

ctags.name: copy_file_with_time
ctags.pattern: /^int copy_file_with_time(const char *dst, const char *src, int mode)$/
